item.fixercity.fixer_longsword.lore: A standard workshop blade. A Grade 9 Fixer's bread and butter.
item.fixercity.fixer_longsword.ability: Right-click: Dash Slash - dash 5 blocks, cutting everything in the path
item.fixercity.fixer_mace.lore: The most reliable argument in the Backstreets.
item.fixercity.fixer_mace.ability: Right-click: Ground Slam - damage and slow nearby foes; stronger while falling
item.fixercity.fixer_dagger.lore: Anyone who shows you their back is already finished.
item.fixercity.fixer_dagger.ability: Passive: 1.75x damage from behind / Right-click: Backstep
item.fixercity.fixer_revolver.lore: Bullets are expensive in the City. Every shot costs Ahn.
key_page.fixercity.rat.lore: A key page that rolls around the bottom of the Backstreets. Cheap to get, cheap to lose.
key_page.fixercity.office_fixer.lore: The body of an ordinary fixer from a small office. Nothing special, but dependable.
key_page.fixercity.zwei.lore: An Association that takes on protection work. Its job is to stand in front and hold.
key_page.fixercity.shi.lore: An Association for jobs that end in one stroke. Long fights do not favor it.
key_page.fixercity.liu.lore: An Association of fiery martial artists. Burns are nothing new.
key_page.fixercity.seven.lore: An Association that deals in information. It reads the enemy and points out the weak spot.
key_page.fixercity.thumb.lore: A soldier of a gun-wielding Syndicate. Not a single bullet is wasted.
key_page.fixercity.kurokumo.lore: A blade-wielding clan. The wounds it leaves do not close easily.
passive.fixercity.scramble.desc: Speed II while at or below 30% health
passive.fixercity.guard.desc: Grants Resistance I to other players within 5 blocks
passive.fixercity.first_strike.desc: If you have not attacked for 5s, the next hit deals 2x damage and 2x stagger
passive.fixercity.blaze.desc: Attacks ignite the target for 3s; fire damage taken is halved
passive.fixercity.analysis.desc: Hit targets become Exposed (+20% damage taken) and Glowing for 5s
passive.fixercity.marksman.desc: +30% revolver damage; 30% chance not to use a bullet
passive.fixercity.bleed.desc: Slash hits add 1 stack of Bleed (max 5)
tooltip.fixercity.page_use: Right-click to equip · Lost on death
item.fixercity.rusty_pipe.lore: The most common weapon in the Backstreets. It hurts. That is enough.
item.fixercity.rusty_pipe.ability: Right-click: Dirty Trick - blind, slow and stagger foes in front
item.fixercity.rusty_pipe.resonance: Double stagger damage + Speed II on yourself (escape)
item.fixercity.zwei_greatsword.lore: A heavy blade swung in order to protect.
item.fixercity.zwei_greatsword.ability: Right-click: Guard Stance (3s) - take 60% less physical damage, counter melee attackers, taunt nearby foes
item.fixercity.zwei_greatsword.resonance: Lasts 5s, 75% reduction, double counter stagger, Resistance II to nearby allies
item.fixercity.shi_blade.lore: The job is done the moment it leaves the sheath.
item.fixercity.shi_blade.ability: Right-click: Flash Cut - cross 7 blocks in an instant; the first target takes 2x damage
item.fixercity.shi_blade.resonance: Stagger 8 on every target; resets cooldown on a kill
item.fixercity.liu_gauntlet.lore: A fist that holds a flame.
item.fixercity.liu_gauntlet.ability: Right-click: Flame Fist - a cone of burning blows, ignites for 5s
item.fixercity.liu_gauntlet.resonance: Range 6, +30% damage, ignites for 8s, Fire Resistance on yourself
item.fixercity.seven_cane.lore: It looks like a cane. It is sharp enough to find a weak spot.
item.fixercity.seven_cane.ability: Right-click: Insight - mark the target you look at with Exposed II and Glowing for 10s
item.fixercity.seven_cane.resonance: Focused target gets Exposed III; all foes within 10 blocks get Exposed I
item.fixercity.thumb_rifle.lore: Load by the rules. Fire by the rules.
item.fixercity.thumb_rifle.ability: Right-click: Fire (pierces 3, stagger 4) / Sneak + Right-click: Reload
item.fixercity.thumb_rifle.resonance: Special rounds - stagger 10 and heavy knockback
item.fixercity.kurokumo_blade.lore: Cuts the same place again, and again.
item.fixercity.kurokumo_blade.ability: Right-click: Flurry - cut foes in front three times, adding Bleed each time
item.fixercity.kurokumo_blade.resonance: Bloodburst - detonate Bleed for 2 damage per stack
item.fixercity.lucky_coin.lore: Everyone who survived the Backstreets has one.
item.fixercity.office_badge.lore: Even a small office is something to belong to.
item.fixercity.office_badge.effect: Stagger recovery starts after 3s instead of 5s
item.fixercity.zwei_armband.lore: Someone wearing this always has someone behind them to protect.
item.fixercity.liu_talisman.lore: Those who wield fire are not burned by it.
item.fixercity.liu_talisman.effect: Half fire damage taken, +15% damage to burning targets
item.fixercity.liu_talisman.resonance: Immune to fire damage, +25% to burning targets
item.fixercity.seven_monocle.effect: Immune to Blindness and Darkness, +10% damage to Exposed targets
item.fixercity.thumb_bandolier.effect: Reload 40% faster, 15% chance to save a bullet
item.fixercity.kurokumo_knot.lore: The more of their blood flows, the less of yours does.
item.fixercity.kurokumo_knot.effect: Heal 1 when hitting a bleeding target (once per second)
item.fixercity.first_aid_kit.lore: No pay if you go down mid-job.
item.fixercity.first_aid_kit.effect: Heal 4 + Regeneration III for 3s + restore 50% stagger
item.fixercity.flashbang.effect: Blind, slow and deal 10 stagger to foes within 6 blocks
item.fixercity.smoke_bomb.lore: They cannot chase what they cannot see.
item.fixercity.smoke_bomb.effect: Invisibility 5s for you and allies within 4 blocks; nearby foes lose track
item.fixercity.painkiller.effect: Strength I and Resistance I for 10s (side effect: Hunger)
tooltip.fixercity.accessory_use: Right-click to wear · One at a time · Lost on death
